messages:
maya: noticing a surge of TLS handshake failures from eu-west proxies to user-service after this morning's keystore RBAC tighten. proxies returning 502 + TLS alert: unwrap denied. snippet: `tls: unwrap error=DENIED principal=proxy-eu-west key=svc/user-service/kek`

sam: which deploy introduced the RBAC change?

deploy-bot: rollout completed 2026-04-02T09:04:12Z by ci/cd#3580 1 keystore-role -> keystore-role-v2 (scoped)

anita: we split keystore roles in the feature branch. did we update proxy bindings?

maya: checking KMS audit: many UnwrapKey attempts marked DENIED with reason "principal missing kms:Decrypt". running query now.

kevin: on the network side I'm seeing mixed SNI values. some client_hello show sni=user-service.legacy and the server cert is for user-service.internal. Could be older sidecars still in cluster.

security-oncall: escalate to P1. immediate steps: 1) stop the keystore rollout in eu-west; 2) gather full KMS audit lines + proxy debug logs; 3) verify SNI->cert mapping; 4) create short rollback if needed.

ops-bot: quick mitigation idea: add temporary serviceaccount binding mapping old role ARN -> new role for proxy pods (ttl 30m). Filing PR now. :handshake:

maya: running a K8s canary rollback of the RBAC change in eu-west cluster. watching unwrap metrics.

deploy-bot: rollback job applied 2026-04-02T09:10:45Z 1 canary rollback completed on 4 pods.

sam: metrics update: unwrap DENIEDs fell from 132 -> 6 in 5 minutes. handshake failures follow same drop.

anita: follow-ups: - add keystore unwrap smoke test to preflight that exercises the exact role mapping - add test for alias-prefix changes (we changed alias prefixes during split) - ensure sidecar image rollout includes updated alias config

kevin: adding SNI probe to proxy e2e: check client_hello.sni matches certificate SANs and fallback alias.

ops-bot: temp mapping PR #804 created to allow old role to assume new role for proxy SA for 1h while callers are fixed.

security-oncall: also: add alert rule in audit pipeline: if KMS Unwrap DENIED > 20/min for a single principal raise pager. we missed early signal.

maya: agree. documenting immediate postmortem items in the incident doc. will draft and tag owners.

anita: note: alias drift could cause proxy to request a key alias that doesn't exist or that is beyond role scope, leading to DENIED even if RBAC is ok. add alias resolution to keystore library tests.

kevin: observed ~28% of failures had client_hello.sni that included `.legacy.`; those pods are still on older sidecar. scheduling forced rolling restart for sidecars in eu-west canary.

security-oncall: containment achieved. assign owners: maya/sam rollback verification, anita keystore CI tests, kevin proxy e2e SNI checks, ops to review rollout gating. create postmortem within 48h. :memo:

ops-bot: will keep the temp binding for 1h unless overridden. PR includes rollback checklist and TTL.

maya: once metrics stable for 30m we can close. also adding runbook blurb: "for any RBAC scope tightening on keystore, run KMS unwrap smoke test on canary proxies + verify SNI/cert mapping before global rollout."

security-oncall: closing when unwrap DENIED < 5/min and handshake failures back to baseline. ping here when complete. :white_check_mark:
